This plot is rented, so I will not put much money into it. I will do it the way I can manage with my own hands, using local seed and no chemical fertilizer, because cash is tight and I do not like risking money on land that is not mine. If I get some manure nearby, I will carry a little and spread it, but I will not buy expensive inputs, and here in Tabora I wait for the rains, I do not irrigate.
